name: DeepGEMM
description_en: DeepGEMM: clean and efficient BLAS kernel library on GPU
readme_excerpt: DeepGEMM DeepGEMM is a unified, high-performance tensor core kernel library that brings together the key computation primitives of modern large language models — GEMMs (FP8, FP4, BF16), fused MoE with overlapped communication (Mega MoE), MQA scoring for the lightning indexer, HyperConnection (HC), and more — into a single, cohesive CUDA codebase. All kernels are compiled at runtime through DeepJIT, requiring no CUDA compilation during installation. DeepGEMM leverages some concepts from CUTLASS…
